about: Which fixture set and systems the headline charts show. Every system and set is in eval/results/index.json, the tables in docs/benchmarks.md and the UI regardless; this only picks what goes on the slide-sized charts. Keys are run-record system.key values.

readme.about: The README results block (pii-guard eval report rewrites the block between <!-- results:start --> and <!-- results:end -->). Every column reads a fixture set's latest snapshot from the run records in eval/results/runs/ (LAB-1656: no dataset-record columns, so the README and the landing read one source). Marks are caveats explained under the table in the README; a column whose best cell is marked gets no bold, and a cell from a run missing some of the set's languages is marked § automatically. over_masking_table prints over-masking for every row; per_language prints the first row's leak per language on the headline set. model_latency names the one model-latency measurement the README quotes (LAB-1625's gateway-latency records were taken under heavy load and are too noisy to quote).

rows.label: PII Guard rules only (no name detection)

model_latency.label: What the NER model (v4.2) takes per message on CPU (the model's own detection time, not the whole gateway; measured alternating with v2.0 in one process on a shared machine)
